posts.title: Motivation for the Smoothed Bootstrap
posts.description: This post discusses the need for smoothed version of the statistical bootstrap. I start with a negative result of the standard bootstrap, and introduce smoothing as a practical, and necessary improvement. Suppose you have 100 unique values and you draw a new sample of 100 observations with replacement. How many unique values would you expect...
